name: Midian
title: Abraham's son and ancestor of the Midianites
summary: Midian was one of Abraham's sons by his second wife Keturah. He became the ancestor of the Midianites, a nomadic people who lived in the areas east of the Jordan and south of Edom. The Midianites played a significant role in Israel's early history, both as allies and enemies.

keyEvents.title: Birth of Midian
keyEvents.description: Midian was born as the son of Abraham and his wife Keturah, after Sarah's death.

keyEvents.title: Received gifts from Abraham
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to Midian and his brothers, and sent them eastward while he was still alive, to secure Isaac's inheritance rights.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Midian
keyEvents.description: Midian had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida, and Eldaah. These became the ancestors of the various clans of the Midianites.

keyEvents.title: The Midianites mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Midian's descendants and his place in Abraham's lineage are confirmed in Chronicles.
